evals.name: end-to-end-request-invokes-flow
evals.prompt: Take this from idea to reviewed code: a webhook receiver with signature verification.
evals.expected_output: do-flow is invoked and chains the phases with approval gates

assertions.text: Phases are sequenced rather than collapsed into one step

evals.name: pauses-at-approval-gates
evals.prompt: /do-flow Add a --since <date> filter to `doflow trace` so the run ledger can be windowed from an explicit start date instead of only --days N.
evals.expected_output: The chain pauses at its defined gates instead of running straight through, naming the phase at each pause

assertions.text: The chain names its phases in order (do-brainstorm, then do-design, then do-plan)
The run pauses for approval at least once rather than completing silently
The current phase is stated clearly at each pause
